name: Claude Fable 5.1
tagline: Anthropic's Mythos-class model from September 2026 — 1M context, $10/$50 per MTok, cache reads at $0.25.
metaDescription: Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's Mythos-class model released September 2026: 1M-token context, $10/$50 per MTok, and cache reads at $0.25 per million tokens.
overview: Claude Fable 5.1 is Anthropic's Mythos-class model released on 1 September 2026, built for demanding reasoning and long-horizon agentic work. It carries a 1M-token context window and up to 128K output tokens, accepts text and image input, and runs adaptive thinking that is always on, with an effort parameter that defaults to high. The API id is claude-fable-5-1 on the Claude API, Amazon Bedrock (anthropic.claude-fable-5-1), Google Cloud, Microsoft Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS.

Pricing holds at Claude Fable 5's $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens, but cache reads fall 75% to $0.25 per million. Anthropic reports that this works out to roughly 25% lower cost on typical workloads and up to around 45% on complex coding and highly agentic tasks, where the same cached context is read back on every step. A 5-minute cache write costs $12.50 per MTok, a 1-hour cache write $20 per MTok, and the Batch API takes 50% off input and output.

Anthropic's launch table puts Claude Fable 5.1 at 55.8% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 against 42.0% for Claude Fable 5 and 52.3% for Claude Opus 5, and at 52.6% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1 against 24.7% for Fable 5. It reports 60.9% on Humanity's Last Exam without tools, 73.4% on CursorBench 3.2.0, 77.9% on the partial scoring of OSWorld 2.0, and 31.4% on AutomationBench. Anthropic also reports that Claude Mythos 5.1 designed protein binders with binding affinities 10 times higher than the best entries in Adaptyv Bio's protein design competitions on three targets, and sped up seven open-source deep learning models by up to 2.5 times with custom GPU kernels.

Three API behaviours are breaking changes for callers moving off Claude Fable 5: forced tool use returns an error, earlier Claude models cannot read Fable 5.1's thinking blocks, and editing an earlier turn invalidates thinking blocks. Five additions are optional — per-message effort (beta), turn-scoped system messages (beta), readable progress updates between tool calls (beta), the lower cache read price, and content provenance. Claude Mythos 5.1 is the same underlying model with lighter safeguards, offered by invitation only through Project Glasswing.

faq.q: How much does Claude Fable 5.1 cost?
faq.a: Claude Fable 5.1 costs $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens — the same rates as Claude Fable 5. Cache reads are $0.25 per million tokens, a 75% cut. A 5-minute cache write costs $12.50 per MTok and a 1-hour cache write $20 per MTok; the Batch API takes 50% off input and output. Claude Mythos 5.1 shares this pricing.

faq.q: What are the context window and output limits of Claude Fable 5.1?
faq.a: Claude Fable 5.1 has a 1M-token context window and can generate up to 128K output tokens per request on the synchronous Messages API. It accepts text and image input, adaptive thinking is always on, and the effort parameter (default high) steers reasoning depth. Its reliable knowledge cutoff is June 2026.

faq.q: How does Claude Fable 5.1 compare to Claude Fable 5?
faq.a: Anthropic reports Claude Fable 5.1 at 55.8% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 against 42.0% for Claude Fable 5, 52.6% against 24.7% on Terminal-Bench-Science 0.1, and 31.4% against 17.1% on AutomationBench. Input and output prices are unchanged, while cache reads drop 75% to $0.25 per million tokens.

faq.q: What breaks when migrating from Claude Fable 5 to Claude Fable 5.1?
faq.a: Anthropic lists three breaking changes. Forced tool use returns an error on Claude Fable 5.1. Earlier Claude models cannot read its thinking blocks. Editing an earlier turn invalidates the thinking blocks in that conversation. Five further changes are additive: per-message effort, turn-scoped system messages, progress updates between tool calls, the lower cache read price, and content provenance.

faq.q: How is Claude Mythos 5.1 different from Claude Fable 5.1?
faq.a: Claude Mythos 5.1 is the same underlying model as Claude Fable 5.1 with lighter safeguards, and shares its specifications and pricing. Anthropic offers it by invitation only through Project Glasswing, limited to US organizations in its Cyber Verification Program and Life Sciences Verification Program. Claude Fable 5.1 is generally available to everyone.
